New town. New school. Bad hair day.

Throw a lifeline to the wilderness.

49081: After crossing paths unexpectedly, Aslı and Kerem fall in love but clashing family backgrounds threaten to stand in their way.

Friday night he's too tired; Saturday night too drunk; Sunday, too far away.

Made to Kill or Love on Command!
